description: This file defines the EAPMController class for handling external account provisioning management within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for processing user actions, handling OAuth authentication, saving and re-authenticating external account information, and managing redirects and error reporting.

classes.name: EAPMController
classes.description: Controller class for managing external account connections and OAuth workflows in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry point for processing user requests, checks admin access.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles error reporting and redirect when external account operations fail.

methods.name: pre_save
methods.description: Pre-processing before saving an EAPM record, initializes API, and validates data.

methods.name: post_save
methods.description: Post-processing after saving an EAPM record, handles OAuth login checks and redirects.

methods.name: action_oauth
methods.description: Handles OAuth authentication flow for external accounts.

methods.name: pre_QuickSave
methods.description: Prepares an EAPM record for quick save, loads login info.

methods.name: action_QuickSave
methods.description: Performs quick save of external account data, handles OAuth if necessary.

methods.name: action_FlushFileCache
methods.description: Flushes document cache for the specified API.

methods.name: remapAction
methods.description: Remaps actions, e.g., DetailView to EditView.
